name: utf8scan
algorithm: UTF-8 validation and full Unicode scalar decoding over a generated mixed-script buffer (ASCII, Latin-1, Greek, Cyrillic, CJK, and 4-byte emoji): validate the whole byte buffer with std, iterate every codepoint, fold the codepoint count and sum, and toggle one ASCII byte between rounds (README.md).

skip.mk-wrap: the checksum already uses the wrapping operators; there is no checked arithmetic to remove

no_counts: B24 does not apply: an idiomatic row compares standard library UTF-8 validators and codepoint decoders; folding the scalar count and codepoint sum checks that every decoder read the exact same codepoints
notes: The input repeats a 4-line mixed-script corpus (1-byte ASCII, 2-byte Latin-1/Greek/Cyrillic, 3-byte CJK/Hangul/Kana/symbol, and 4-byte emoji) n times. Between rounds one leading ASCII byte ('T'/'t') is toggled by XOR 0x20 so validation and decoding cannot be hoisted.
Mk's standard library names its Unicode scalar iterator str.Scalars (yielding char), paired with str.From for validation.
